user.title: EV Charge Planner
user.description: Pick the source entities and vehicle/charger parameters.

data_description.charge_limit_entity: Target for the "full" scenario. Without it, 100 % is used.
data_description.charger_min_power_w: Lowest power the wallbox charges at on three phases (≈4.1 kW). Without phase switching, surplus below this is not used.
data_description.baseline_mode: Household load subtracted from forecast PV: rolling average of the house consumption sensor, or a fixed value.
data_description.baseline_fixed_w: Used in fixed mode, and as fallback in rolling mode until house load data is available.
data_description.forecast_extra_entities: Optional later days (Solcast day 3–7 sensors) to extend the PV horizon beyond tomorrow.
data_description.phase_switching: The wallbox drops to one phase when surplus is low. PV surplus then counts from the single-phase minimum (≈1.4 kW), up to the single-phase maximum (≈3.7 kW at 16 A).
data_description.solar_share_pct: How much of the charger's minimum power must come from solar before solar charging starts. 100 % = pure solar. Lower values let the grid top up weak solar to the minimum power (the grid part is shown as grid_topup_kwh).

error.min_above_max: Minimum power must not exceed maximum power.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration is possible.
